scope: V2 practice and answering layouts; preserve behavior
prompt:
Design a polished, high fidelity web application UI composition comparison board for Jazz Ear Lab V2. OPTION B — CENTRAL PRACTICE STAGE. Two viewport mockups side by side: a desktop landscape on the left, a real narrow portrait mobile on the right. No device hardware or perspective. Board labels outside frames only: "B — CENTRAL PRACTICE STAGE", "Desktop", "Mobile". These are two sizes of the SAME Progression Recognition state: all six answers filled, ready to submit.

Reference image supplies ONLY existing black/yellow identity, Source Sans 3 humanist typography, cool #f5fbfe open background, white native selects, square 1px gray borders, flat restrained components. Replace reference's left-sidebar composition. No gradients, shadows, cards inside cards, music-themed decorative graphics, progress metrics, invented claims or waveforms. KEEP real navigation: Jazz Ear Lab, Practice, Insights, Legacy. On mobile brand goes on the first line and all THREE text navigation items remain visible on the second line. NO HAMBURGER MENU or hidden navigation.

NEW structural thesis: ONE CENTERED VERTICAL PRACTICE STAGE. At desktop center a bounded 880px column within broad quiet side margins; everything shares that center axis. Existing compact yellow session band above spans the stage width with Progression Recognition, Question 3 / 10, Stop. Under it, large centered "Dm7 → G7 → Cmaj7" on ONE LINE as the musical anchor, with small "4 beats each · 80 BPM" below it. Then a distinct centered white-secondary "Replay whole progression" control. Fine gray horizontal rule. Heading "Your answers" left-aligned at the start of the answer area; small right-aligned "Ready to submit". Answer area is an open THREE-ROW TABLE, NOT chord columns: each row has chord label at left (1 · Dm7, 2 · G7, 3 · Cmaj7) and two native answer selects side by side at right under Note1 and Note2 column headers. Exact answer values: Dm7 b3 and5; G7 3 and b7; Cmaj7 maj7 and9. All six selects show filled values, so primary yellow "Submit all answers" is enabled. Primary submit spans the full width of the centered practice stage beneath the three answer rows. Put the replay control under the musical anchor above the response section, NOT beside submit. Small "2 notes per chord" supporting text. This visual grammar serves every mode: music above, response stage below, primary action last. Do NOT add any new workflow, per-note editing drawer, step navigation, playback button, grading action or extra state.

Mobile preserves the very same vertical order, all three chords in a compact wrapping musical header, replay, three chord-labelled answer rows with two side-by-side native selects per row, and one full-width Submit. Fit typical six-note case cleanly within the portrait viewport at comfortable native control and text sizes. Structured, compact, strong hierarchy, confident whitespace; distinctly a centered single-stage layout instead of a sidebar or full-width three-column sheet. Finished Operate UI, not a wireframe.
